biotools.summary: STIM is a package and pipeline for multiplicity of infection (MOI) and haplotype detection of *P. falciparum* malaria from 24-SNP barcode-based NGS assays. It builds upon StrainPycon and is used to assess temporal changes in transmission dynamics.
